description: Overview of all projects ("missions") listed on the portfolio. Details for each project are in projects/individual/.

projects.name: CropCore
projects.summary: CropCore is an AI-powered smart farming assistant using ML and computer vision for crop monitoring, weed detection, disease diagnosis, and yield prediction with IoT sensor integration for real-time irrigation optimization.

projects.name: CareerTrack
projects.summary: CareerTrack is an AI-powered career platform developed as an Initial Validation Prototype (IVP) to help students and early professionals succeed in today's competitive job market.

projects.name: AutCore
projects.summary: AutCore is an AI-driven autism screening and risk assessment tool.

projects.name: KRED
projects.summary: KRED is an AI-powered financial intelligence platform that analyzes user behavior and projects long-term financial outcomes through behavioral insights, life simulations, retirement planning, and an AI financial assistant, helping users make smarter financial decisions by visualizing future financial scenarios and personalized recommendations.

projects.name: DiscAgeAI
projects.summary: DiscAgeAI combines 3D CNN volumetric analysis of lumbar MRI scans with biomechanical metadata regression to predict intervertebral disc biological age and degeneration grade.

projects.name: PACDI
projects.summary: PACDI (Precision Adaptive Climate and Dosage Intelligence) is an IoT greenhouse management system with ML-driven climate optimization.

projects.name: DiagEnc
projects.summary: DiagEnc is a medical image security system that performs CNN-based fracture detection to identify diagnostically critical regions, then applies selective AES-256 encryption to those regions while maintaining lossless image quality.

projects.name: SSL-RUL
projects.summary: SSL-RUL introduces a self-supervised pretraining strategy for Remaining Useful Life (RUL) prediction in industrial machinery.

projects.name: PKStruct
projects.summary: PKStruct is a PyPI-published Python package providing 20+ production-grade data structure implementations including thread-safe linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, heaps, and graphs.

projects.name: POLARIS
projects.summary: POLARIS is a universal-grade agentic RAG system built on LangGraph orchestration with Groq inference for sub-second response times.

projects.name: GIL
projects.summary: GIL (Geometric Information Learner) is a published Python ML package that applies information geometry principles to tabular learning.

projects.name: CMS Price Transparency Platform
projects.summary: The CMS Price Transparency Platform ingests machine-readable hospital price files mandated by the US Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (2021 rule) and transforms them into a searchable, filterable analytics interface.

projects.name: Synthetic Taphonomic Deformation
projects.summary: This research pipeline processes 3D CT slice stacks of fossil specimens (8 specimens x 30 projections = 240 images per specimen) via orthographic maximum intensity projection (MIP) and rotational view generation.

projects.name: FitAI
projects.summary: FitAI is an agentic RAG assistant for gym-goers, with structured user context and a domain knowledge base.

projects.name: RL Studio
projects.summary: RL Studio is a self-healing reinforcement-learning platform focused on detecting and recovering from hidden training and environment problems.

projects.name: Synq
projects.summary: Synq is a phone-to-laptop connectivity project intended to provide wireless input, media, clipboard, and file-transfer capabilities.
